caption: Create a dated JSON archive and a Markdown report.
eval: (async()=>{ const p = app.plugins.plugins['annotator-json-export']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({"status":200,"json":{"data":{"viewer":{"login":"demo-reader"},"user":{"sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor":{"isActive":true,"isOneTimePayment":false,"tier":{"name":"$5 a month","monthlyPriceInCents":500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('annotator-json-export-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await p.openActive(); for(const selector of ['.aje-dated','.aje-ack']) document.querySelector(selector).click(); document.querySelector('.aje-save').click(); await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{let attempts=0; const poll=()=>{if(document.querySelector('.aje-status')?.textContent.startsWith('Created ')) return resolve(); if(++attempts>100) return reject(new Error('Export did not finish')); setTimeout(poll,50);}; poll();}); return 'ok'; })()
